name: Nerawareta Tsuma Sakuna ~Katsute Chika Idol Datta Tsuma ni Tsuki Tsuke Rareru Yuganda Yokubou
original_name: 狙われた妻・咲菜 ～かつて地下アイドルだった妻に突きつけられる歪んだ欲望
source:
Shusuke Hisada and Sakina went on many dates and eventually got married in an ordinary and happy marriage.
Shusuke was happy with his wife Sakina and their mundane but happy life and sex.
However, she has a secret: she used to be an underground idol in the past.

Sakina used to be a member of the underground idol group "Mukohaiyohoi" under the name of "Natsuno Hidamari".
The group's style of performing was extremely extreme, with the emphasis on close contact with their fans,
Sakina has been active in her idol career as she was forced by the management to do so, using the so-called "Gachi-Koi" method, which is a way of encouraging fans to fall in love with her.
However, this was never what she wanted,
Even now, three years after she stopped her idol activities, she is still haunted by the fact that she has played with people's psychology.
She doesn't want to do this anymore.

Sakina wanted to live an ordinary life. From now on, she and her beloved husband will always be .......

However, her ordinary happiness was easily destroyed by the past.

You're Hidamari-chan, aren't you?

A fan named Itsu Okimiya suddenly called out to Sakina on the street, a fan who had a serious crush on "Natsuno Hidamari".

Sakina finds out that she is married to Itsu Okimiya.
But Sakina, who used to be an underground idol, is now a fan of Hidamari Natsuno,
Sakina does not want her husband to know that she used to be an underground idol with an extreme line.
However, this only ignites Okimiya's anger and outburst,
His distorted thoughts and desires are directed toward Sakina....
translation:
久田周介和萨金娜经历了多次约会，最终以平凡而幸福的方式结婚了。
周介对他的妻子萨金娜以及他们平凡但幸福的生活和性生活感到满意。
然而，她有一个秘密：她曾经是一名地下偶像。

萨金娜曾是地下偶像团体“Mukohaiyohoi”的成员，名字为“Natsuno Hidamari”。
组合的表演风格极其极端，强调与粉丝的近距离接触，
萨金娜一直活跃在她的偶像事业中，因为她是被管理层强迫的，使用所谓的“Gachi-Koi”方法，这是鼓励粉丝爱上她的一种方式。
然而，这从来都不是她想要的，
即使在她停止偶像活动三年后的今天，她仍然对自己玩弄人们心理的事实感到困扰。
她不想再这样做了。

萨金娜想过平凡的生活。从此，她和她心爱的丈夫永远……

然而，她平凡的幸福却轻易被过往所破坏。

你是向阳酱吧？

一位名叫大宫一的粉丝突然在街上向深爱“夏野向阳”的粉丝萨金娜喊道。

萨金娜得知自己已与冲宫逸结婚。
但曾经是地下偶像的萨金娜现在却是夏野向阳的粉丝，
萨吉娜不想让丈夫知道她曾经是一个走极端路线的地下偶像。
然而，这只会激起冲宫的愤怒和爆发，
他扭曲的思想和欲望都指向萨金娜……
